releases.name: v0.15.3 — Outward-link metadata in Review preparation
releases.body:
# v0.15.3 — Outward-link metadata in Review preparation

- Integrate #314's Review-only outward-link reporting. Retained external artifact scope can contain links outside declared physical roots without stopping before Reviewer Task creation. Record link identity, link text, canonical target and the reason its target was not inspected; never read or recursively traverse the out-of-scope target through those links.
- Keep an explicit uninspected-target count and representative paths outside the 24,000-byte source preview budget, so a full excerpt cannot hide that coverage limit. Link changes affect the Review fingerprint; uninspected target content is not claimed as reviewed or fingerprinted. An explicitly scoped target remains eligible for ordinary collection.
- Preserve strict default `declaredArtifacts`, formal validation snapshots and manifest/write gates. Actual writes through links outside declared write scope still fail. Existing internal, dangling and cyclic-link handling is retained.
- Align package/lock version, Mission marker and 15 current install pins across five guides. Preserve #311's tactical/bilingual reporting and prior release/test/migration evidence. Prior v0.15.2 npm version/latest/integrity/SHA-1 propagation is confirmed without repeating its accepted upload.

## Review and evidence boundaries

Before integration, collect the PR body, ordinary comments, review bodies and inline comments. The earlier independent Medium finding (uninspected coverage notice lost when the excerpt filled) is valid and already corrected with a retained regression. Final `SELF_RECHECKED` is author self-check, not independent PASS. Codex failed/usage-limit notices are unavailable external review, with no concrete returned code finding or independent PASS.

Reuse the final 43-pass focused Review check, two supplementary write-boundary checks and all four successful exact-head Linux/Windows CI checks. The artificial old broad scope plus new narrow proof fixture demonstrates public Reviewer Task creation, not recovery of the real KF1/Proton environment. The originally rejected link remains unidentified; a `z: -> /` analogue establishes the route, not that exact incident's link name. [Diagnosis and retained limits](https://github.com/zufall-upon/Sortie-dogs/blob/2a84798fec6b98b131157d9c538d918a07f1c1b7/docs/review-external-link-fix-2026-10-30.md).

## Fixed release routine

Freeze one integrated main commit and tarball/SHA-256, then isolated candidate preflight, one mandatory full suite, exact-commit Linux/Windows CI and actual Terra/max Worker startup. Startup proves actual Worker/model identity only, not Mission completion or official scoring. Do not replay unchanged original Missions or restart stopped benchmarks.

Apply the identical archive to both existing npm global prefixes and the OpenCode config-local plugin dependency. Compare all regular package files and eight runtime assets, preserve explicit settings, then fixed tag, GitHub Release and `npm publish <tgz> --access public --tag latest`. Accepted publication is recorded once; registry propagation is checked separately without republish on a temporary 404. Retain logs, costs, review dispositions and identities in `_testenv/releases/0.15.3/`.

Mission marker: `0.15.3-external-review-links-v1`. Codex skill marker remains `0.14.6-codex-skill-v1`. Existing Mission state, cumulative consumption and unknown costs remain intact. No game/Steam/Proton/prefix/OS/driver/torch/ROCm/model environment changes, raw history edits or automatic shared-host restart. Manual OpenCode reload and actual saved-result Reviewer Task recovery remain separate, pending steps; disk installation alone does not prove the running host loaded this fix.

releases.name: v0.15.2 — Tactical return reports and bilingual insignia
releases.body:
# v0.15.2 — Tactical return reports and bilingual insignia

- Integrate #311's tactical-desk return report: short headings and naturally wrapping paragraphs retain costs, model breakdown, gauges, PACK history, unknown values, scope, evidence and next actions. Long model identifiers remain literal text with layout-only break opportunities.
- Add receipt-bound conditional insignia `rare.clean-sweep` (Quiet Strike) and `rare.recovery-coordination` (Unbroken Formation). Persist the first evaluation for the formal receipt and reuse it across both public delivery paths. Unknown/legacy histories, reopening and repeated rendering do not grant new awards or count aliases twice. Activity overlap is not proof of causally successful collaboration; frequency is unmeasured.
- Render Japanese or English on each delivery using `SORTIE_REPORT_LOCALE`: omitted/empty preserves Japanese, `ja` variants select Japanese, other explicit values fall back to English. Locale changes presentation, not IDs, rules, saved decisions or counts. User/model prose and IDs remain untranslated.
- Retain static guidance to copy host-authored workload labels into the next useful ordinary update, without progress-only calls, invented percentages or extra model turns. These estimates describe the whole request's workload, not time, spend, budget or completed-unit share.
- Align package/lock version, Mission marker and all current install guides. Prior v0.15.1 npm version/latest/integrity/SHA-1 propagation is confirmed; its accepted upload was not repeated. v0.15.0/v0.15.1 tags, archives and historical evidence remain unchanged.

## Review and evidence boundaries

Collect existing PR bodies, ordinary comments, review bodies and inline comments before integration. Retain #311's already-corrected public-delivery findings and failing-then-passing regressions. Codex failed/usage-limit notices are unavailable external review, not concrete code findings or PASS. Native independent Review remains `EVIDENCE_GAPS`; final author self-recheck and external ChatGPT GO are not independent PASS or formal whole-request acceptance.

Reuse the PR's focused storage/display/caller tests, successful exact-head Linux/Windows CI and recorded root WebUI observations without repeating unchanged Missions or external consultations. Recorded bilingual narrow-layout/long-ID UI checks do not establish OS clipboard behavior, an expanded-panel screenshot or actual new-insignia acquisition.

Task subtitle live updates remain unrepaired; no general automatic progress-copy guarantee is claimed. The earlier real Mission's ordinary-text progress/panel observation is not proof that the later insignia were acquired in a real task. Do not spend, dispatch, rerun, manufacture failures or skip validation for decoration.

## Release verification and delivery

Freeze one integrated main commit and tarball/SHA-256, then isolated candidate preflight, one mandatory fixed-candidate full suite, exact-commit Linux/Windows CI and actual Worker/model startup. The startup probe proves Worker identity only, not Mission completion, independent acceptance or official scoring. No stopped SWE/Frontier evaluation is resumed.

The first release full run exposed one stale caller assertion: the new paragraph renderer separates `NEXT` and its retained value with two newlines, while `mission-completion.test.ts` expected one. releases.name: v0.15.1 — Review recovery with retained artifact scope
releases.body:
# v0.15.1 — Review recovery with retained artifact scope

Fixes a v0.15.0 stability defect: a dangling symlink in retained external artifact scope could abort `review_mission` with `ENOENT` before Reviewer dispatch. v0.15.1 records link identity and explicit target-missing state in the fingerprint and bounded preview instead. Permission errors, loops, unexpected I/O and resolved out-of-scope links remain failures; missing required outputs still fail validation.

## Fixed artifact

- Release commit: `6a0a5764500884155e24ff06416e1aac86f51d8d`
- Package: `sortie-dogs-0.15.1.tgz`
- SHA-256: `a0505a4a5937e5a57be387591a189c2fd29387295f310a27913d284ed95a5f91`
- Runtime marker: `0.15.1-dangling-review-v1`
- Fix PR: #309; qualification-documentation PR: #310. The final documentation-only merge did not change the qualified runtime source, dist or tarball bytes.

## Qualification and deployment

- Main candidate: related tests 41 passing; full validation covered 133 files, exit 0 (404.47 seconds native elapsed). Existing v0.14.9 migration and nonempty-reflection preservation evidence retained.
- Installed-package OpenCode 2.2.0 / `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`: retained broad scope → narrow validation → independent Review → acceptance receipt. One validation execution; link and proof preserved; no tool errors; 133.937 seconds. This isolated result does not claim that a cancelled previous shared-host Mission resumed.
- Independent source Review: PASS, no Major/Medium findings. Candidate preflight: exit 0, 10.331 seconds, matching `v015` profile, assets verified, no provider requests started.
- All 253 regular package members matched at both npm global prefixes and the config-local plugin package. Eight global runtime assets, marker, CLI targets and the wrapper's ESM package resolution matched. Eighty-three existing configuration, service, reflection, project-memory and other-plugin files were preserved byte-for-byte.
- Delivery recovered a CLI-link removal caused by `npm install --bin-links=false` using supported `npm rebuild`; original link text/targets were restored. This was detected and corrected before tag/Release; inode identity is not claimed unchanged. An initial verifier used CommonJS resolution for an ESM-only export; the verifier was corrected to use ESM resolution.

## Migration and retained limits

Use the attached fixed package and SHA256SUMS. See [migration and qualification details](https://github.com/zufall-upon/Sortie-dogs/blob/6a0a5764500884155e24ff06416e1aac86f51d8d/docs/v0.15.1-migration.md). Do not bypass failures by editing ledgers, deleting historical scope or removing unrelated links. The user-approved version replacement retained original requirements, artifacts, failure history, evidence and cumulative consumption; reviving the cancelled Mission ID is not an additional release prerequisite.

v0.15.0's tag and assets remain unchanged and its Review defect remains documented. No shared-host restart/reload, stopped benchmark inference or grading was performed. Disk installation does not prove the loaded version of an already-running host. Actual cumulative cost remains unknown; the existing 300-unit ceiling and consumption are retained. At initial GitHub Release publication, npm publication was deferred and `npm publish` had not been run. See the publication follow-up below. The existing config-local `ini@7.0.0` Node-engine warning remains recorded; no unrelated dependency or Node replacement was performed. Root Mission acceptance is separate from this Release publication.

releases.name: v0.15.0 — Project Memory, return reports and recovery
releases.body:
> **Known stability issue / 既知の安定性問題 — fixed in v0.15.1**
> v0.15.0 can abort Review with `ENOENT` when retained external artifact scope contains a dangling symlink. Its tag and assets are preserved; do not treat v0.15.0 as the accepted stable migration target.
> The qualified fix is available as [v0.15.1](https://github.com/zufall-upon/Sortie-dogs/releases/tag/v0.15.1), with a fixed package and SHA256SUMS. Follow its migration and deployment notes. npm publication remains manual and has not been performed by this release task.
> Preserve original requirements, evidence, failures and cumulative consumption. Do not edit ledgers, remove historical scope or delete unrelated links to bypass the issue. The version replacement does not claim that a cancelled previous Mission resumed or that an already-running shared host loaded the installed package.

# v0.15.0 — Project Memory, return reports and recovery

- Opt-in lightweight Project Memory retains vision, constraints, decisions, corrections, original-source references and unresolved work across sessions. Memory is not execution authority or validation evidence.
- Model-replaceable Advisor consultation and result/disposition recall; browser ChatGPT consultation was a development method, not a shipped dependency.
- Restore the host-authored game-style return report exactly once in the native final reply, using formal receipts and measured values.
- Preserve scoped symlink replacement while rejecting unauthorized target writes; recover prepared Mission registration idempotently on the retained run; separate implementation-unit budgets from retained validation consumption.

## Validation and identity

Fixed release commit: `befbf63be6d51d66606124ea00666b79fe21028d` (PR #308, following #306/#307).

One fixed archive: `sortie-dogs-0.15.0.tgz`, SHA-256 `20e126e74906284c64feeae5779edd5872700988a850f58c6e482422c41e78c4`.

- Isolated 0.14.9 upgrade preserves existing state/settings and Memory-off behavior. Real OpenCode V2/SOL interruption resumes the same Mission/unit through formal validation, independent Review, Acceptance and one return report.
- Nonempty reflection storage, caller-visible injection, kill switch and re-enable behavior survive the upgrade without additional model inference.
- Final integrated Linux full suite: 2,452 passing / 4 skipped / 0 failing, exit 0; build plus test phases 409.093 seconds. Skips are two Docker-dependent and two live Codex cases, not verified coverage.
- Exact-commit Linux/Windows CI succeeded. Independent native Review reported no Major/Medium findings. External automated PR review failed at its usage limit; that is not an independent PASS.
- Matching v015 package/asset preflight succeeded. Separate startup smoke observed SOL/xhigh and explicitly selected Terra/max Worker startup in 20.069 seconds. Startup stop exit 130 and canonical exit null are not task completion.
- Both existing npm global prefixes and OpenCode's config-local dependency match the attached archive byte-for-byte. Existing explicit settings/reflection/other-plugin files remain unchanged. Installed files do not prove that an already-running host loaded the new version.

Retained controller failures, recovery history, partial/unknown costs and validation-freshness rerun reasons remain in the development evidence. These bounded checks do not claim universal recovery, desktop GUI rendering, image generation or new Codex memory capture. No stopped benchmark was resumed.

npm publication remains manual and was not performed by this release operation. The shared OpenCode host was not restarted.
